# Quote: Juniper Lane Dental

**Quote #:** BW-[____] | **Date:** [____] | **Valid until:** 30 days from issue date
**Prepared for:** Mary Major, Office Manager | **Prepared by:** Bluewick IT

---

## 1. Summary

Juniper Lane Dental has four urgent problems:

- **Backups:** The last successful backup was four months ago, and the practice-management database holds patient records.
- **Security:** The office has no business firewall.
- **Wi-Fi:** The current Wi-Fi is consumer-grade and does not cover the office properly.
- **PCs:** The staff workstations are due for replacement.

This quote covers new PCs, a secure network, encrypted backups and ongoing managed support. Together these support your HIPAA obligations. Bluewick will sign a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) with the practice, and the cloud backup vendor also signs a BAA.

The full scope is **$18,838.50**, which is above your $15,000 budget. **Section 7** offers a phased option that fits the budget. We recommend it.

## 2. Scope

**Workstations**
- Supply and deploy 10 new staff PCs.
- Migrate user data and settings to the new PCs.
- Reuse your existing monitors.

**Network**
- Install a business firewall with a security subscription.
- Install a 24-port managed PoE switch, replacing the 8-port unmanaged switch.
- Install 3 business Wi-Fi access points for full coverage.

**Backup**
- Install an on-site backup appliance.
- Add encrypted cloud backup, with the vendor signing a BAA.
- Back up the practice-management database and imaging data.
- Run a documented test restore.
- **Backup work is scheduled first.**

**Managed support**
- Monthly support, monitoring and patching for 11 users.
- This includes the 2 operatory imaging PCs.

**Project management**
- Scheduling, coordination and handover documentation.

## 3. One-off costs (full scope)

| Item | Qty | Unit price | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Business PC (i5, 16 GB RAM, 512 GB SSD) | 10 | $960.00 | $9,600.00 |
| Wi-Fi access point | 3 | $347.00 | $1,041.00 |
| Firewall appliance | 1 | $640.00 | $640.00 |
| 24-port managed PoE switch | 1 | $720.00 | $720.00 |
| Backup appliance | 1 | $1,200.00 | $1,200.00 |
| **Hardware subtotal** | | | **$13,201.00** |
| PC deployment and data migration (2.5 h per PC) | 25 h | $125.00 | $3,125.00 |
| Network installation | 10 h | $125.00 | $1,250.00 |
| Backup setup and test restore | 6 h | $125.00 | $750.00 |
| Project management (10% of labour) | 4.1 h | $125.00 | $512.50 |
| **Labour subtotal** | | | **$5,637.50** |
| **Total one-off** | | | **$18,838.50** |

## 4. Recurring costs

| Service | Qty | Unit price | Monthly | Annual |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Managed support | 11 users | $95 per user per month | $1,045.00 | $12,540.00 |
| Encrypted cloud backup (vendor BAA) | 1 | $150 per month | $150.00 | $1,800.00 |
| Firewall security subscription | 1 | $420 per year, billed annually | n/a | $420.00 |
| **Total recurring** | | | **$1,195.00 per month, plus $420 per year** | **$14,760.00** |

## 5. Totals

| | Amount |
|---|---|
| One-off project (full scope) | $18,838.50 |
| Recurring, first 12 months | $14,760.00 |
| **First-year total** | **$33,598.50** |

## 6. Assumptions and exclusions

**Assumptions**
- The $15,000 budget covers one-off project costs only. Recurring services are a separate operating cost.
- The existing cabling can reach the access point locations. If new cable runs are needed, we will quote them separately.
- The new PCs include Windows 11 Pro licences.
- Your data volume fits the standard cloud backup plan. We will confirm this during setup.
- Work takes place during business hours, and we will schedule it around patient appointments.

**Exclusions**
- **Replacement of the 2 imaging PCs.** These run SensorView v6, which the imaging vendor certifies only on specific hardware. We can quote their replacement once the vendor confirms approved hardware and signs off.
- Monitors, which are being reused.
- Software licences, such as practice-management and Microsoft 365 licences.
- Changes to your internet service.
- Secure disposal of the old PCs. We can quote this on request.
- HIPAA risk assessments, policies and staff training. We can support these, but they remain the practice's responsibility.
- Sales tax, where it applies.

## 7. Options

| | Option A: Full scope now | **Option B: Phased (recommended)** |
|---|---|---|
| What it includes | Everything above | **Phase 1 (now):** all network, firewall and backup work, plus 7 PCs. **Phase 2 (later):** the remaining 3 PCs |
| Hardware | $13,201.00 | Phase 1: $10,321.00 / Phase 2: $2,880.00 |
| Labour (including project management) | $5,637.50 | Phase 1: $4,606.25 / Phase 2: $1,031.25 |
| **Total** | **$18,838.50** | **Phase 1: $14,927.25 / Phase 2: $3,911.25** |
| Deposit on acceptance | $6,600.50 | Phase 1: $5,160.50 / Phase 2: $1,440.00 |
| Within budget? | No ($3,838.50 over) | **Yes** |

**Why we recommend Option B**

- **It fixes the biggest risks first.** Phase 1 delivers all of the backup, firewall and Wi-Fi work. These address the practice's most serious exposures: patient records without a recent backup and a network without a firewall.
- **Deferring three PCs carries the least risk.** We will choose the three healthiest existing PCs with you to keep until Phase 2.
- **Phasing adds no cost.** The combined price of both phases equals the full-scope price.
- **Phase 2 can follow when budget allows,** for example next quarter. If Phase 2 starts after this quote expires, we will re-confirm hardware prices at that time.

## 8. Terms

- This quote is valid for 30 days from the issue date.
- A 50% deposit on hardware is due on acceptance. The balance is due on completion of each phase.
- Managed support and cloud backup are billed monthly from go-live. The firewall subscription is billed annually in advance.
- Bluewick will sign a BAA with Juniper Lane Dental before we access any patient data.
- The solutions in this quote support the practice's HIPAA obligations. Compliance remains the practice's responsibility.

---

## Cover email to Mary Major

**Subject:** Your IT quote from Bluewick IT

Hi Mary,

Thanks for having John visit. Your quote is attached.

The full scope comes to $18,838.50, which is above your $15,000 budget. We've therefore included a phased option at $14,927.25. It covers the new Wi-Fi, a business firewall, encrypted backups and 7 new PCs now, with the remaining 3 PCs to follow later. We recommend this option.

Your last successful backup was four months ago, so we would start with the backups. Both Bluewick and our cloud backup provider will sign Business Associate Agreements to support your HIPAA obligations.

Your two X-ray imaging PCs aren't included in the replacement. Their imaging vendor must approve any new hardware first, and we're happy to coordinate that with them.

Ongoing support and backup services come to $1,195 per month, plus $420 per year for the firewall subscription.

The quote is valid for 30 days. Happy to walk you through it anytime.

Best regards,
[Name], Bluewick IT
